title: Open-source Hydra Head L2 Web based Explorer and API

ms.promise: Detailed initial design documentation for the Hydra Head L2 Web Explorer.
ms.criteria: Documentation is well-structured describing all planned inner workings in detail. The documentation describes the current architecture of the Hydra Head, the current way of viewing the different scenarios happening inside the Hydra Head, and why it is not very convenient for developers. The documentation describes different scenarios that can happen inside a Hydra Head and it describes how the proposed Hydra Head L2 Explorer will support them.

ms.report:
Dear reviewer, 
We completed the actual code and testing for M1, M2 and M3 at the same time, long before we could submit the evidence for M2 as M1 review took a month plus there was a change request; hence, there will not be visible changes in the PoA submission evidence which is the final output file.
It would help if you looked at the initial code implementation, tests carried out, and final code (not diff between PoA). There's the code and docs that were written before the last few commits which are the milestone's evidence and substance.
Regarding your comment: Please explain anything behind the scenes that you think a standard open-source project coding should, or at least a new Cardano coder knows where to start to replicate API code and end API endpointsThis is not in scope of this Milestone. Video was to showcase code is working. Guideline is to be delivered in M4.
SO looking at the outputs and evidence requested for Milestone 2, all is summarized below:
Repository: https://github.com/WingRiders/hydra-explorer
Instructions how to run the api server locally: https://github.com/WingRiders/hydra-explorer/blob/master/README.md#running-the-application
Instructions how to run the unit tests: https://github.com/WingRiders/hydra-explorer/blob/master/README.md#running-tests
The video to illustrate that L2 Explorer API works without any major issues: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2BLCXdHjWrw
The video link is also present in https://github.com/WingRiders/hydra-explorer/blob/master/API.md

ms.criteria: L2 Web Explorer works without any major issues and is available to be used by any Hydra developer. The explorer is showing all important data and actions that are happening inside the connected Hydra head.
